name: ibis Jakarta Senen
short_description: A 148-room economy hotel on Jalan Kramat Raya in Central Jakarta's Senen district, 5 minutes from Senen Train Station and 8 minutes from Gambir Train Station.
ai_summary: ibis Jakarta Senen is a 3-star economy hotel at Jl Kramat Raya No 100 in Central Jakarta, about 5 minutes from Senen Train Station, 8 minutes (3.5 km) from Gambir Train Station, and 7 minutes (2.7 km) from the National Monument (Monas). The property was renovated in 2024 and offers 148 upgraded rooms across four room types, all 18 sqm with city views and 43-inch smart TVs, including connecting family options. On-site facilities include The Taste restaurant with a buffet featuring local dishes, a lounge bar, spa services, and six meeting rooms for business travelers. Its own Accor listing shows a strong 4.7/5 ALL rating from 107 reviews, and independent guest reviews from late 2024 and early 2025 consistently praise friendly, attentive staff, clean rooms, and the convenient Senen-district location, though a minority of reviews mention limited breakfast variety and compact room sizes. The hotel fully participates in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme.

faqs.question: How far is ibis Jakarta Senen from Jakarta's train stations?
faqs.answer: The hotel is about 5 minutes from Senen Train Station and roughly 8 minutes (3.5 km) from Gambir Train Station, Jakarta's main long-distance rail hub, making it a convenient base for travelers arriving by train or connecting onward across the city by rail or toll road.

faqs.question: How many rooms does ibis Jakarta Senen have and were they renovated?
faqs.answer: The hotel has 148 rooms across four room types, including connecting family options, all sized at 18 square meters with city views and 43-inch smart TVs. Accor's own listing confirms the rooms were upgraded as part of a 2024 renovation, giving the property a notably fresher look than older economy-tier competitors nearby.

faqs.question: Does ibis Jakarta Senen participate in the ALL loyalty programme?
faqs.answer: Yes -- unlike some ibis budget properties in Jakarta, ibis Jakarta Senen fully participates in ALL - Accor Live Limitless, so members can earn and redeem status points and access member-exclusive rates on top of the hotel's own strong 4.7/5 guest rating from 107 reviews.
